Name: Glenburn Repairs. Style: Repairs and safety checks for homes and landlords. Address: 2 Mill Wynd, Glenburn NG1 (example). Works in Scotland.
Area: We cover Glenburn and Kirkhill: NG1 to NG3.
Office hours: Monday to Friday: 8am till 5:30pm. Saturday: 9am till 12 noon. Closed Sundays. Out of hours, an engineer is on call for emergencies.

Trades: gas, boilers and heating; boiler servicing and gas safety records; plumbing and leaks; drains and blockages; electrics, EICRs and PAT; roofs and gutters; carpentry and handyman; locks and lockouts; glazing and boarding up; damp and mould; fencing and gates. Doesn't do: pest control (suggest the council).
Visits: morning 8am to 12 noon, afternoon 12 noon to 4pm and all day 8am to 4pm (£15 extra). Emergencies, day and night: we aim to attend within 2 hours and make safe within 24.

Prices: Call-out £75, with the first hour, then £30 a half hour. Nights and weekends: £150 for the first hour. A landlord's gas safety record is £65 for one appliance, plus £15 for each extra one. A boiler service is £85, or £130 for both on one visit. Free quotes over £500. Guarantee: Our workmanship is guaranteed for 12 months; parts carry the maker’s warranty.
Payment: Homeowners pay on completion by card or bank transfer; landlords and agents on account, within 14 days. Cancellation: Cancel any time before we set off.
Accreditations: Gas Safe 512345 (example), NAPIT. Insurance: £5 million public liability (example).

Asbestos: If we find anything that might be asbestos, we stop and arrange for it to be tested before any work goes on. Parking: Please let us know about any parking restrictions; a permit or a space on the drive helps. Careers: We’re always glad to hear from qualified engineers: take a message and the office will call back.
